An illegal migrant repeatedly raped a woman in Germany, hoping that gathering a child with her would protect him from a deportation order issued by the German authorities.
Yusufcan S. (20 at the time), a Turkish-Kurdish man, arrived in Germany in February 2024 and applied for asylum.
His application was rejected as unfounded and he was ordered to leave the country.
He left, then re-entered illegally in October 2024.
He lived on social benefits and worked as a wedding singer.
German authorities issued two deportation orders.
He contacted a 26-year-old nurse via Instagram and started spending time together with her.
At the end of March 2025 he wanted to have sex with her. She refused. He then repeatedly raped her. She became pregnant.
Prosecutors say his motive was to father a child with a German citizen so he could claim a residence permit as the father and avoid deportation.
He also threatened to stab her to death if she did not carry the pregnancy to term.
On 5 June 2025, he grabbed her by the wrist, dragged her into Heilbronn Town Hall and forced her to sign a formal acknowledgment of paternity. When she tried to leave the queue, he punched her in the face.
He was arrested a week later. The Heilbronn District Court accepted her account and sentenced him to 3 years and 2 months in prison.
Both sides appealed and the case is still at the Heilbronn Regional Court.
It’s unclear whether he will get deported.

「国策だから」で済ませるな。何を達成すれば成功で、失敗時の負担は誰が負うのか。検討段階の今こそ、条件と効果を国民に説明しろ。

自治会任せで済ませるな。事業者の責任、相談窓口、違反への対応まで具体化しろ。住民の暮らしを守れないルールに意味はない。

私は日本が大好きです。❤️🇯🇵

意見が違うなら、主張の中身で反論しろ。名古屋駅前の街頭演説に、拡声器を使って抗議する映像だ。
